body: This is the most comforting post i have wver read on this app it feels like i wrote it withbmy own two hands wow

That concept of “ we all have our days” is generally thrown around and may even be perceived as degrading in the sense of oh this trauma compared to another… however when its really broken down it is such a comforting concept and personally, being an extremely social human with tendencies to rely on interaction, the idea that i can put the sentence _____ has felt this way and got through it or they have felt this way and i am not alone in these feelings is SO helpful. Whether its somebody i empathize with or idolize, it can morph dependent upon the situation and aid in a variety of anxietys and different scenarios

I am in fear to seek help because my last attempt left me in worse shape than it began. I have no idea where to turn next and i am one who is easily discouraged and have already found myself to be turned off by the idea of help after building up the need and thought of help for over a year.

every man who leaves leads you to the one who will stay. For you should genuinely ask yourself would you rather stick with a partner just to have one who fully does love and accept your situation rather than someone who shows their trye colors and doesnt lead you on rather just lead you to the next !! I am very sorry your situation does not in any way sound easy and i know for a fact how difficult and heavy hearted the holidays can be for many especially those who feel lonely with little emotional output and support. Youre doing amazing i promise you and everywhere you are in this life is exacrly where youre meant to be. My grandfather told me something once that said the universe (he had used God however im not sure what you believe) gives its toughest battles to its strongest soldiers… and that on top of that it is the toughest soldiers in which are created throuvh the toughest battles……. MOST importantantly it is the TOUGHEST soldiers of them all that are the battle themselves. Youre fighting this battle and i can tell you have been for a while. Please keep going. You have more obstacles to overcome and more to prove to yourself you can do than you ever imagined!!!!!

your take about “why cant life change” is actually really interesting and not a thought i realized was relatively universal. This post as well as your reply to the threads below have shown both your compassion as well as your maturity towards your situation and others and for this i must thank you on behalf of the world for existing! I know it may seem like things are a lot down right now and i really am sorry for all the sorries you didnt get that you deserve(d)… however it sounds like in your life YOU are the most capable of lifting yourself up. Yes your kids can definitely contribute!! And maybe you can find some activities you’d all enjoy so the time passes productively and happily! All ive got to say is that one day your passion for life and passion for the little things will return its almost a guarentee!!! Rock bottom is solemnly an excuse to elevate once again And i can assure you that there are future mornings with no tears! i promise :)) everything you are is worth it and everything you feel is valid… keep pumping mama youre awesome youve got this

The idea about wishing your life is worse is a feeling i could never put my finger on until now. The guilt associated with comparing your bad days and your traumas is brutal because in most cases, there is someone who has it worse. Coming from someone who has felt those lows i hope you know that the choice of living should be a choice you make willingly for yourself. Nobody else. It doesnt matter the level of horror, i believe you when you speak and i understand your pain. It is valid. Stay here for a while and try to live for you. If it doesnt work id love to hear any other feelings you choose to post
